name: 2026 Topps Allen & Ginter
lede: Minis, celebrity autographs, rip cards and a deep rookie class. What's in 2026 Topps Allen & Ginter, and what we pulled from it live on Whatnot.
facts: 24 packs per box, 8 cards per pack, 12 boxes per case
2 hits per hobby box: autograph, relic, rip card or printing plate
300-card base set, plus minis, inserts and parallels
about: Allen & Ginter mixes baseball with celebrities and non-sports subjects. The checklist includes framed mini autographs, full-size autographs, relics, and rip cards: hobby-exclusive cards you can keep sealed or tear open for an exclusive mini inside. Parallels include Foil Filigree (Blue /150, Green /99, Gold /50, Orange /25, Black /10, Red /5 and 1/1s), along with Chrome, mini metal, stained glass and wood minis.
The rookie class includes Munetaka Murakami, Kyle Teel, Bryce Eldridge, Carson Benge, Justin Crawford, Owen Caissie and Trey Yesavage.
how: We broke 2026 Allen & Ginter in random team breaks at Cheap Sunday Morning Breaks on Whatnot. Because A&G has celebrity and non-sports cards, the break included a Non-Sports / Celebs spot alongside the MLB teams.
